title: viola walteri var. appalachiensis
intro:
Viola walteri var. appalachiensis, commonly known as Mountain Panke, is a flowering plant species native to the southeastern United States. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Mountain Panke include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Viola walteri var. appalachiensis include isovitexin, which is believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. 

Note: There is limited information available about Viola walteri var. appalachiensis, however some sources suggest that it is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments.
